summary:
Slice 1 (stack setup) is finished and committed on feat/ui-shell in two commits: 79bf7d6 (dependencies, PostCSS/shadcn config, generated components) and 5e7971a (globals.css layering, token codemod, fonts, theme provider, CSS layer test). The previous attempt's uncommitted work was reviewed and kept in part. Its step 4 of §7.1 was unfinished: it still had @import "tailwindcss" with preflight, the raw oklch tokens and the self-referential --font-sans. Its CSS codemod matched the design and was kept. globals.css was regenerated from HEAD, so the unrelated blank-line churn is gone.

What landed:
- **Dependencies:** tailwindcss 4.3.3, @tailwindcss/postcss, postcss, next-themes 0.4.6, react-resizable-panels 4.14.8, class-variance-authority, cmdk, tw-animate-css, shadcn 4.22.1, cn, and radix-ui pinned to 1.4.3. The pin means the shadcn components and Radix Themes share one copy of the Radix primitives (verified after a clean `bun install --frozen-lockfile`).
- **Config:** postcss.config.mjs and components.json, created by `shadcn init -b radix --defaults`, so style is radix-nova and baseColor is neutral. Aliases are set to @/app/components, @/app/components/ui, @/app/hooks, @/lib/utils and @/lib. No stray components/ directory.
- **Components:** 26 files in app/components/ui (the 24 listed plus input-group and toggle as dependencies) and app/hooks/use-mobile.ts. They lint clean. Dialog and sheet overlays/content use z-[9994]; popover, select, dropdown-menu and tooltip content use z-[9998].
- **app/globals.css structure:**
  - The layer statement and the two partial Tailwind imports (no preflight).
  - Radix Themes styles imported into layer(radix) (the import was removed from layout.tsx).
  - tw-animate-css and shadcn/tailwind.css imports, the dark custom variant, and the Inter @font-face.
  - `@theme inline static` with --font-sans set explicitly, radius 4/6/8px, and the --font-heading line deleted.
  - :root and .dark shadcn tokens mapped onto the Radix sand/indigo/red scales.
  - Legacy alias blocks; --list-row-* now uses indigo/sand, which fixes the upstream values that never resolved at :root. --surface-1, used but never defined upstream, is now defined.
  - The .radix-themes bridge, the scoped base reset, the z-index ladder comment, and the rest of the upstream CSS wrapped in @layer legacy.
- **Codemod:** applied to globals.css, the CSS modules and ImageNode inline styles. --accent-2-strong/-bg/-border are deleted. 100vh became 100dvh for `main` and `.app-shell`.
- **Fonts:** Inter 4.1 is vendored at public/fonts. It is byte-identical to `web/InterVariable.woff2` and `LICENSE.txt` from the official v4.1 zip (checked by SHA-256 and the wOF2 header); the README records version, source and checksums. HtmlMessage injects the same @font-face into the srcdoc and uses the family. The compose editor uses var(--font-sans). There is no next/font anywhere.
- **Layout and theme:** layout.tsx has `<html suppressHydrationWarning>` and the next-themes ThemeProvider (attribute="class", storageKey="noctua:theme", enableSystem) around `<Theme accentColor="indigo" grayColor="sand" panelBackground="solid">`. The inline Radix colour overrides moved to the CSS bridge.
- **next-themes vs MailClient:** MailClient no longer toggles the .dark class or writes localStorage. It derives darkMode from `useTheme().resolvedTheme` and its toggle calls `setTheme`, so the two no longer fight.
- **Tests:** app/globals.test.ts (7 tests) compiles globals.css through @tailwindcss/postcss. It checks the layer order and the .rt-BaseDialogOverlay 9995 / .rt-PopperContent 9998 rules. It also checks there is no preflight and no unscoped element rule outside the radix/legacy layers, that only the token blocks are unlayered, that the font and radius variables are emitted, that the Inter face matches lib/ui/fonts.ts, and that no legacy file reads var(--muted)/var(--accent) with the old meaning. I broke the file on purpose (full Tailwind import, wrong layer order) and the test failed as expected.
- **Dev smoke test** (localhost, temporary data dir): the page hydrates, Inter loads, and with no stored theme the OS dark setting gives `html.dark` with color-scheme dark and dark tokens.

Two problems from the dev smoke test:
- My `pkill -f 'next dev'` was a mistake. It probably also killed other `next dev` processes on this machine. The user's /home/monkey/code/mainPage dev server shows a 07:55 start time, so it was likely restarted. A team-auth dev server may have been killed too.
- My first dev runs used the NOCTUA_DATA_DIR=../noctua-data-team-auth setting from .env.local. That created or opened scratch/noctua-data-team-auth/db/main.db (07:54:54), and startup printed an admin invite code. I did not delete it because I can't be sure whether it is shared with team-auth.
checksRun:
- `bun test app/globals.test.ts`: 7 pass.
- `bun run test:ci` (run twice, the second time after the final CSS change): 1667 pass / 0 fail in the main run, 12 pass / 0 fail in the DOM run.
- `bun run build` (twice, the second after the final change): exit 0. The built CSS keeps the layer order properties, theme, base, radix, legacy, components, utilities; the Inter @font-face, the z-[9994]/z-[9998] utilities and `.rt-BaseDialogOverlay{z-index:9995}` are all in the output.
- `bun run lint`: 28 problems (1 error, 27 warnings), the same as a HEAD baseline. The one error is upstream's useCalendarConflicts.ts. The new anonymous-default-export warning in postcss.config.mjs was fixed.
- `bunx tsc --noEmit` compared against a HEAD baseline (built from a `git archive` copy): the only new error is the expected `bun:test` module error in app/globals.test.ts.
- Manual check of globals.css: no new unscoped element selectors outside @layer legacy (the test enforces this too).
- Dev-server smoke test in the T3 preview on localhost: hydrates, Inter loads, the system dark theme applies.
openIssues: Design conflict: D10 says shadcn style `new-york`, but the verified §7.1 step 2 command (`init -b radix --defaults`) produces style `radix-nova`. I kept radix-nova, the output of the explicit steps. To switch, change components.json and re-add the components with --overwrite; the z-index edits would then have to be re-applied.

Design deviation: §7.1 lists clsx + tailwind-merge, but the shadcn 4.22.1 registry components import `cn` from the `cn` package (shadcn's drop-in replacement) and declare it as a dependency. I kept `cn`; lib/utils.ts re-exports it. Rewriting the generated imports would diverge from every future `shadcn add`.

Design deviation: the design's @layer base only has the box-sizing/border reset and cursor:pointer. I added a preflight subset that applies only to elements carrying data-slot (margin/padding 0, inherited heading sizes, no list markers, transparent form controls with inherited font and colour). Without it, ghost/link shadcn buttons show the browser's default button background and text colour, and dialog titles keep browser h2 margins. Kept components inside shadcn frames are not affected.

Design deviation: `@theme inline static` instead of `@theme inline`. Tailwind only emits theme variables that the compiled CSS or class names use; CSS modules are not scanned, so without `static` the --radius-sm/md/lg and --font-sans values the CSS modules rely on would disappear once globals.css stops using them.

radix-ui is pinned to 1.4.3 to share one primitive instance with @radix-ui/themes. A later `shadcn add` will probably `bun add radix-ui` at the latest version and split the instance again: re-pin to 1.4.3 and run a clean `bun install` afterwards. cmdk brings its own @radix-ui/react-dialog 1.3.1, which shadcn's CommandDialog does not use.

Not done in this slice: the shell rules (.app-shell, .content-grid, .pane, .resizer, .auth-*, .auth-overlay at z-index 9999) are still inside @layer legacy because MailClient and LoginOverlay still use them. The design wants them removed together with AppShell and LoginScreen.

react-resizable-panels 4.14.8, which the shadcn registry's resizable.tsx targets, has no `autoSaveId` or `order` props, so the §7.2 plan (`autoSaveId="noctua:panes"`, id + order) has to use `useDefaultLayout({ id, panelIds, storage })` and panel ids instead.

The radix-nova Tooltip does not wrap its own provider. No TooltipProvider is mounted in the layout, because §7.1 asks for that only with Base UI. Header tooltips need a TooltipProvider ancestor; SidebarProvider already includes one.

The detached windows (app/message/window/page.tsx, DetachedComposeWindowClient.tsx) still compute darkMode from localStorage === "dark". With next-themes now putting .dark on their <html>, a stored "system" theme (or none) with a dark OS gives dark window chrome but a light email iframe until slice 2 adds the planned useSyncExternalStore hook.

Environment side effect: my `pkill -f 'next dev'` during the smoke test probably killed other `next dev` processes on this machine. The user's /home/monkey/code/mainPage dev server shows a 07:55 start time, so it was likely restarted; a team-auth dev server may have been killed too.

Environment: wt-ui-shell/.env.local sets NOCTUA_DATA_DIR=../noctua-data-team-auth, so dev runs from this worktree and from wt-team-auth would share one database. My first dev runs created or opened scratch/noctua-data-team-auth/db/main.db (07:54:54, startup printed an admin invite code). I did not delete it. Later dev runs used NOCTUA_DATA_DIR=/tmp/... and that directory has been removed.
Dev server: opening it via http://127.0.0.1 does not hydrate, because Next 16 blocks dev resources for origins not listed in `allowedDevOrigins`. Use http://localhost:<port>.
notesForNextSlice:
COMMITS on feat/ui-shell: 79bf7d6 (dependencies, postcss.config.mjs, components.json, lib/utils.ts, app/components/ui/*, app/hooks/use-mobile.ts) and 5e7971a (globals.css restructure, codemod, fonts, layout ThemeProvider, MailClient theme change, app/globals.test.ts). The working tree is clean.

NEW HELPERS:
- `lib/ui/fonts.ts`: `APP_FONT_FAMILY` ("Inter"), `APP_FONT_URL` ("/fonts/InterVariable.woff2"), `APP_FONT_STACK`, `APP_FONT_FACE_CSS`. Use these for any document that does not load globals.css, such as other srcdoc iframes. app/globals.test.ts checks that the @font-face in globals.css matches them.
- `lib/utils.ts`: `cn` (re-export of the `cn` package). Generated shadcn files import `cn` from "cn" directly.
- `app/hooks/use-mobile.ts`: `useIsMobile()` (shadcn's hook, 768px breakpoint, returns false on the first render).
- `app/components/ui/*`: alert, avatar, badge, button, card, command, dialog, dropdown-menu, input, input-group, label, popover, resizable, scroll-area, select, separator, sheet, sidebar, skeleton, switch, table, tabs, textarea, toggle, toggle-group, tooltip. Style is radix-nova on the radix-ui primitives.

CSS CONTRACT (app/globals.css):
- Layer order: theme, base, radix, legacy, components, utilities. Tailwind adds its own `properties` layer before all of them.
- Everything from upstream lives in `@layer legacy`. Unlayered: the token blocks, the .radix-themes bridge and shadcn's .shimmer. CSS modules are unlayered too, so they beat Tailwind utilities.
- Tokens: shadcn tokens on :root/.dark map to Radix --sand-N, --indigo-N and --red-N (never --gray-N, --accent-N or --space-N at :root).
- Legacy aliases: --bg, --surface, --surface-1/2/3, --text, --link, --input-bg/fg, --mail-view-bg/fg, --list-row-*, --shadow, --quote-2. --muted, --accent and --border now carry their shadcn meaning (background fills / border).
- app/globals.test.ts fails if a file under app/ or lib/ (outside app/components/ui) reads var(--muted) or var(--accent). In CSS modules use --muted-foreground / --link for the old text and link colours, or var(--color-muted) / var(--color-accent) for the shadcn fills. `@theme inline static` emits the --color-* variables on :root.
- Radius: --radius is 0.5rem; --radius-sm/md/lg are 4/6/8px and come from @theme.
- Base reset: box-sizing and borders for [data-shell] and [data-slot] subtrees, plus a preflight subset only on elements that themselves carry data-slot. Raw buttons and inputs inside [data-shell] that are not shadcn components still have browser default styling.
- z-index ladder (documented in the CSS): calendar 9990 < shadcn overlay/content z-[9994] < .rt-BaseDialogOverlay 9995 < poppers z-[9998]. The .auth-overlay 9999 rule is still present.
- The `font-heading` class used by generated components does nothing on purpose (the design removes --font-heading); headings inherit Inter.

THEME STATE (slice 2 does the full hookup):
- layout.tsx has `<html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>` and `<ThemeProvider attribute="class" storageKey="noctua:theme" enableSystem>` around `<Theme accentColor="indigo" grayColor="sand" panelBackground="solid">`. `suppressHydrationWarning` is also still on <body>, as upstream had it.
- MailClient has `const { resolvedTheme, setTheme } = useTheme(); const darkMode = resolvedTheme === "dark";` and `handleToggleDarkMode` calls `setTheme(darkMode ? "light" : "dark")`. The darkMode state, the mount effect and the manual class/localStorage writes are gone. resolvedTheme is undefined on the first render, so darkMode flips false→true after mount, the same as upstream.
- Slice 2 still has to: build the useSyncExternalStore-over-classList hook the design asks for (correct on the first render, so the HtmlMessage iframe is built once); use it in MailClient and in both detached windows, which still read localStorage; and put the theme toggle in the new header.

STILL TO DO FROM §7.1/§7.2 (not in this slice):
- Remove the .app-shell, .content-grid, .pane, .resizer and .auth-* rules once AppShell and LoginScreen replace them.
- Use `<Theme asChild>` inside shadcn Sheet/Dialog/Popover content that hosts kept Radix components.
- react-resizable-panels is v4: `ResizablePanelGroup` wraps `Group`, there is no autoSaveId/order, persistence goes through `useDefaultLayout`, and conditionally mounted panels need `panelIds`.
- Tooltips from app/components/ui need a TooltipProvider ancestor; mount one in the shell, or rely on SidebarProvider, which includes one.

DEPENDENCY CAVEAT: radix-ui is pinned to exactly 1.4.3 so it is shared with @radix-ui/themes. After any `shadcn add`, check package.json (the CLI may bump radix-ui), re-pin, and run `rm -rf node_modules && bun install` so that node_modules/@radix-ui/themes/node_modules/radix-ui does not exist.

DEV TIPS:
- Open the dev server on localhost, not 127.0.0.1 (127.0.0.1 does not hydrate under Next 16 `allowedDevOrigins`).
- Run dev with `NOCTUA_DATA_DIR=/tmp/<something>` to stay away from ../noctua-data-team-auth, which .env.local points to. Process env takes precedence over --env-file.
- Never use `pkill -f 'next dev'`; other Next servers run on this machine. Kill only your own PIDs, checked with `readlink /proc/PID/cwd`.
